messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert PD-83912 fired for SVC-API: 5xx rate increase > 3% over 2m. Escalation policy 'prod-oncall' fired. Primary: Ash (ack deadline 5m). Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-83912 :rotating_light:

Ash: Acked. Looking now. I'm on my way into a deploy though, could be related. Will update in 2.

Leo: Noted. If you step out, I'll watch the page. Can someone post quick customer impact? Any SLOs breached?

Sara: Support queue showing 5 new "500 internal" from a customer on EU region, ticket #12345. I'm escalating to CS.

Ash: I'm seeing elevated 502s hitting /v1/generate — tailing logs:
```
[2026-03-15T23:12:01Z] svc-api-3 error: upstream timeout id=abc123 status=502
```
Deploy started 23:10 UTC, rolling batch. Suspect new model worker version.

incidentbot: Secondary on-call Leo paged (no ack after 2m). Escalating to manager: Elaine (PM) paged.

Elaine (PM): I'm awake, joining bridge. Which cluster? Are we in prod-us or prod-eu?

Leo: Prod-us first, seems to be hitting both. I'm hopping into the deploy logs.

Ash: I need to step out to finish deploy step. Leo, please take over. I've added a deploy pause: `ci pause deploy --job svc-api/rollout`

Leo: Got it. Pausing. Confirmed new task group svc-api-v2 started rolling at 23:10 and several instances returning 502. Rolling back the latest batch. Running: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/svc-api --to-revision=3`

Sara: CS notified primary customer, they saw 10 failed requests. ETA for rollback?

Leo: Undo started, checking pods. ```kubectl get pods -l app=svc-api -o wide``` shows old pods restarting. Health endpoint checks: `curl -sS https://svc-api.internal/health | jq .status`

Elaine (PM): If rollback fails, fallback is to switch traffic to backup region. Prep a DNS failover plan. Also loop in infra.

Ash: pinging infra-ops: @DevOps-SVC can you confirm any infra network issues? We saw timeouts to model-hosts around same time.

DevOps-SVC: No network alerts. Looks like memory pressure on model-host-12 after the v2 worker deployed; OOMKill spikes. Investigating. :mag_right: 

incidentbot: PagerDuty updated: Secondary didn't ack within policy window; manager escalation delivered. Incident status: acknowledged by Leo at 23:18 UTC.

Leo: I'm seeing OOMs from model-host-12 causing backend errors; scaling down worker concurrency should help. Applying scaledown: `kubectl scale deployment/model-worker --replicas=2`

Sara: CS updated customer that we're rolling back and expect service normalization within 10m. Ticket #12345 updated. :white_check_mark:

Elaine (PM): Good. Keep timeline snappy. Post here when 50% of requests return 200.

Ash: Back online now? I'm seeing 200s return on staging.

Leo: 50% 200s at 23:21 UTC, 90% at 23:24. Rollingly validated. I'll keep monitoring.

DevOps-SVC: The OOM source was incorrect worker config in new image. We'll block that image from future rollouts until patch.

incidentbot: Incident PD-83912 resolved by Leo. Root cause: v2 worker memory regression + deploy during peak. Duration 14m. Please file a postmortem with mitigation: image gating, deploy time window, automated rollback test.

Elaine (PM): Agreed. Leo/Ash/Sara, can one of you kick off postmortem doc? Assign to eng-ml + infra.

Ash: I'll start the doc and link runbook. Tagging @oncall-runbook-owner for follow-up.

Leo: leaving monitoring alerts on for 2h. :eyes:

Sara: Closing ticket after final confirmation.
